A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DMWM research. Their complete main texts and appendices are readable, and corresponding equations, tables and figures can be matched despite reformatting and reordering.

before.justification: v1 reports original DMC experiments on logical consistency, trial efficiency, data efficiency and performance across imagination horizons, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original DMC results and reports additional robotic evaluations, TD-MPC2 comparisons and reasoning-depth experiments.

M1.justification: The stated System 1 prediction loss drops the c_t likelihood term present in v1 Equation 1 from v2 Equation 2. The RSSM/LINN architecture, logical operators, recursive reasoning and Algorithms 1–2 otherwise remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a corresponding implementation change.

E1.justification: Beyond the retained 20 DMC tasks, v2 evaluates four ManiSkill2 manipulation tasks involving cubes and faucet turning, and four MyoSuite tasks involving key turning, object holding, pen twirling and reaching. These substantially broaden evaluation into robotic manipulation and hand control.

E2.justification: TD-MPC2 is newly evaluated in the retained DMC trial-, data- and horizon-return comparisons, including v2 Figures 10–12. Existing comparators remain; Tables 2 and 6 still compare logical consistency against Dreamer, Hieros and HRSSM.

E3.justification: v2 adds robotic evaluation settings, including action repeats and step budgets extending to five million steps, and evaluates reasoning depths 10, 30 and 50 across horizons. The existing DMC settings, general hyperparameters and 100-test-episode evaluation convention are retained.

E4.justification: v2 adds a focused sensitivity study of reasoning depth across imagination horizons, shown for four tasks in Figure 9 and all 20 DMC tasks in Appendix H.5. The earlier logical-correlation heatmap and horizon analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions report 100-episode summaries, mean/variance logical-consistency tables and shaded standard errors. The added depth plots contain error bars, but no new statistical estimation procedure, independent training-run count, seed reporting or significance testing is specified.

E6.justification: v2 adds robotic returns, TD-MPC2 results and reasoning-depth curves. Some existing plotted values also change: GD-MPC's Cartpole Balance return at horizon 30 is approximately 500 in v1 Figure 6 and 430 in v2 Figure 8. All numerical entries in logical-consistency Tables 2 and 6 remain identical.

T1.justification: v2 explicitly defines the previously generic consistency function as C(phi) = Sim(phi, T) and specifies its transition implication in Appendix C. This is a limited mathematical-definition refinement; the ELBO derivation and logical regularizers are otherwise retained from v1.

C1.justification: The central claims concerning dual-process world modeling, recursive logical reasoning and inter-system feedback remain. Both versions retain the headline improvements of 14.3%, 5.5-fold, 32% and 120%; the robotic evaluations broaden support for the existing claims.

C2.justification: v2 interprets its new depth study as showing benefits from deeper reasoning with diminishing returns and increased computational overhead. The stated limitation concerning predefined domain-specific rules and the proposed future direction of learning rules remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-access statement, specifies that the truth vector T is randomly initialized and fixed, and explicitly connects consistency to similarity. Table 3 adds robotic action dimensions and repeats, while Table 4 directs readers to TD-MPC2's reference for its settings.

R1.justification: v2 adds references on collaborative and disentangled world models, long-term prediction and dual-process intuitive physics. Its new main-text related-work section largely summarizes material already present in v1's appendix; the central research positioning remains.

P1.justification: v2 revises introduction and contribution wording, adds a main-text Related Work section and appendix contents page, and moves the impact statement and ELBO derivation. Much of the method exposition, experimental discussion and limitations text is retained.

P2.justification: The main text changes from two columns to a single-column layout. Performance figures are redrawn with TD-MPC2, selected main-text plots shrink from eight panels to four, and robotic and depth-study figures are added. Table 3 expands, while the framework diagrams and correlation heatmap retain their content.

improvement.justification: The robotic evaluations, TD-MPC2 comparisons and depth study strengthen evidence for applicability and design choices beyond v1's DMC evaluation. Added implementation definitions and code-access information also help. The gain is limited by sparse documentation of the new evaluations, undefined depth-study error bars and Figure 9's caption incorrectly describing horizon size as environment trials.
